cv.name: Rui Correia
cv.headline: Teamlead Logistics Ops – Air & Ocean | GDP pharma logistics | Log. Coord.
cv.summary: Logistics professional with eleven years in freight forwarding and pharma distribution around Basel. I coordinate temperature-controlled air and ocean shipments, keep customs and GDP documentation in order and lead a small operations team.

experience.title: Teamlead Logistics Ops – Air/Ocean (GDP)
bullets: Lead a team of 6 coordinators handling about 900 pharma shipments per month
Customs clearance through Passar and e-dec with brokers in Basel and Zurich
Reduced temperature excursions on air lanes by 40% through new packaging and lane assessments
Main contact for GDP audits by customers

experience.title: Sr. Logistics Specialist (FG 8)
bullets: Planned cold-chain shipments to distributors in 30 countries
Maintained SAP EWM master data and carrier rates

experience.title: Log. Asst / Disponent
bullets: Booked barge and truck transports from the Rhine port

education.degree: Federal Diploma Logistics Specialist (eidg. FA Logistikfachmann)
